notes: GAAP (modified accrual funds). Governmental lines from the Total column of the governmental funds statement (p5); ending_cash = governmental funds Balance Sheet cash and cash equivalents 13,892,791 (p4; restricted cash 2,947,028 and CDs 63,204 shown separately). Taxes 9,585,146 split: Sales Tax Fund 4,791,589 (= Statement of Activities sales tax), Hotel/Motel Tax Fund 181,734 (lodging, fund name), TIF funds 186,100 (property tax increment, fund name); remaining 4,425,723 (General sub-fund, Debt Service, Street) stays unlabeled because the Statement of Activities breakdown does not tie and the budget schedules are budgetary basis. Bond proceeds 7,581,439 = debt_proceeds; sale of assets 93,405 = other_financing. Business-type: Water + Sewer from p7 (operating + nonoperating; interest expense and bonding costs as debt service interest); prior period adjustment (6,263,714) recorded as business_type restatement; operating 'Other' 4,327,547 is shown as general revenue 'Other income' on the Statement of Activities (not charges for services). Proprietary cash flows from p8. Detail: General Fund budget schedules (revenues p12, expenditures/other financing p10; chosen over the less detailed General Fund combining statement p16 to avoid double counting), Street Fund budget (p13-14; warrant income printed among revenues), Keno Fund budget (p15), TIF funds combining statement (p17, 5 funds). Zero-actual budget lines (federal grants, insurance proceeds, street insurance/car expense/rental, keno transfer out) not recorded. Debt Service Fund and proprietary funds have no supplementary schedule. Balance sheet: government-wide Statement of Net Position (p1-p2), per column. Read pages 1-17 of 17
